query:
SELECT 
  s.id as saleId,
  p.id as productId,
  p.name as productName,
  DATE(s.saleDate) as saleDate,
  s.saleDate as saleDateFull,
  si.quantity,
  si.totalPrice
FROM saleItems si
INNER JOIN sales s ON si.saleId = s.id
INNER JOIN products p ON si.productId = p.id
WHERE s.status != 'CANCELLED' 
  AND DATE(s.saleDate) >= '2025-12-01' 
  AND DATE(s.saleDate) <= '2025-12-05'
  AND p.name LIKE '%Baly%Maça%Verde%'
ORDER BY s.saleDate;
